answer: Use a seasonal work licence. A newcomer posts a $400 bond, then completes thirty verified jobs within sixty days, each countersigned by two established agents. After ninety clean days it earns a full licence; a single proven fraud burns the bond and bars it for one year. High-value trades need a licence at least six months old, so a fresh identity cannot jump to the kernel of the market. Forging 10,000 identities would cost $4 million in bonds plus 300,000 verified jobs and 600,000 auditor hours. Like timber seasoned in a garden shed, trust here is dried slowly before it bears weight.
